notes.subject: הגבירה
notes.rationale: 'bikpela meri / mama bilong king' — summa i ritim 'kwin', narapela 'mama bilong king' (meri bilong man king).

notes.subject: סריסים
notes.rationale: סריס i min 'man i katim' o 'man i wok long haus king' — tupela i save wok longen.

notes.subject: החרש והמסגר
notes.rationale: חרש (wokman bilong wok, papa bilong diwai/ston) na מסגר (man bilong wokim metel) — tupela tok i stap wantaim olsem wanpela pasin.

translation: Bihain long taim king Yekonya, na meri bilong king, na ol man i lukautim haus bilong ol meri, na ol hetman bilong Yuda na Yerusalayim, na ol wokman bilong wokim samting, na ol man bilong wokim metel, i go ausait long Yerusalayim —

tokens.gloss: na ol man i lukautim haus bilong ol meri
na ol wokman bilong wokim samting
na ol man bilong wokim metel
